subject: Kickoff: behavioral dispositions eval for the assistant
body:
Hi team,

Kicking off the behavioral-dispositions workstream. This is our framework that adapts established psychological questionnaires into Situational Judgment Tests - realistic user-assistant scenarios instead of self-report statements - and measures whether a model's recommended actions match the distribution of human preferences.

The asset is real: 2,500 SJTs, each validated by three annotators, with preferred actions from 10 annotators per SJT drawn from a 550-person pool. The headline finding (models overconfident in low-consensus scenarios, and frontier models missing high-consensus answers 15-20% of the time) is exactly what our assistant team needs as a pre-launch gate.

Goal: productize this as a standing eval in Evalline, run against every assistant model candidate. Milestones: corpus + harness onboarding by early June, first gated model report mid-July, launch review by 8/3.

Bao - staffing and platform plan please.

Priya
